metadata.name: Mercapturic acids
metadata.description: Mercapturic acid is a condensation product formed from the coupling of cysteine with aromatic compounds. It is formed as a conjugate in the liver and is excreted in the urine. Glutathione-S-transferase adducts lose glutamate and glycine portions, and are acetylated to form mercapturic acids, which are excreted
